top_signals.title: Windward Intelligence Report: October 22
top_signals.summary: Windward is publishing intelligence reports on the crisis in the Gulf as the situation develops.From today’s brief: Iran named the Hormuz subsea cables as targets this week, with an IRGC spokesman warning that new targets and new weapons would be unveiled.The attack campaign widened on two fronts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: The National Ocean Industries Association (NOIA) has named the American Bureau of Shipping (ABS) and Ørsted the winners of the 2026 NOIA Environmental, Social, & Governance (ESG) Excellence Awards. ABS is the winner of the Service, Supply & Support category…

top_signals.title: Microsoft blames ConnectWise attacks on Chinese state hacker using ARTEX AI agents
top_signals.summary: A Chinese government-aligned hacking group used automated tools to carry out the recent supply chain attack on IT management software company ConnectWise and is using the same techniques to try to compromise organizations around the globe, Microsoft said.
